clock.input: synthetic UT1 transported as ISO Z strings, not historical physical UTC
clock.conversion: TT Julian day =2440587.5 +(synthetic UT1 Unix seconds+69)/86400
clock.ttVsTdb: Request TT explicitly and require JDTT in returned header. Horizons handles TT-to-TDB internally; no client TT-as-TDB substitution.

limits: Reuses earlier dates deliberately for attribution; not independent blind-holdout evaluation.
Mercury and Venus use body centers; Mars through Pluto primary rows use system barycenters, as in the prior Q31 comparison.
Optional body-center controls diagnose reference-target sensitivity; they do not establish the engine model target center.
ICRF versus the engine EQJ/J2000 axes still requires explicitly labeled frame-bias treatment.
Independent-frame projection is separate from same-engine-frame controlled ablation.
A finite vector comparison cannot establish all-epoch error bounds or global event completeness.
